name: PlayerRadar-Server
display_name_zh: 玩家雷達 - 伺服器端
description_zh: 伺服器端 player 位置廣播器。掃所有 PalPlayerCharacter 寫到共用 JSON 檔，讓 client 端 UE4SS mod 讀。32 人 dedi server 也能在 client 端看到全部人。
source: CrazyChips 2026-08-02 (replaces BREEDER's static marker logic with a live JSON broadcast)

server._note: Server-only UE4SS Lua mod. Configure config.lua's output_path to a Windows file share that the client-side PlayerRadar-Client can read.
